personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with Tactile gamification elements
personality_one_liner: A premium, travel-magazine editorial aesthetic grounded in warm, historic earth tones, blended with playful, touchable gamification mechanics.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing for breathing room, combined with intentional padding inside chunky gamification cards.

do's: Use frosted glass on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers over scrolling maps and imagery.
Use glass overlays on hero cards with gradient-to-dark scrims to ensure readability.
dont's: Do not use glass on regular quest list rows or form inputs.
Do not skip the dark gradient scrim behind text on glass over bright images.

screens.name: Explore
screens.purpose: A visually rich, magazine-style feed of cities and landmarks to inspire exploration.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with subtle shimmer on surfaceSecondary.
states.empty: Illustration of a map and compass, 'No destinations found nearby.'

screens.layout: Editorial layout: Large full-bleed or wide featured hero image with a gradient-to-dark scrim and Fraunces title (e.g., 'Discover Rome'). Horizontal scrolling category tabs (Historic, Museums, Must-See). Vertical list of large cards for landmarks below.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Interactive map showing user location, POIs, and active quests.

states.empty: N/A - map always has base layer.
states.error: Error message overlay if GPS fails.

screens.layout: Full-screen map view with custom styled markers. Floating glassmorphism search bar at top. Bottom sheet for selected POI details. Floating Action Button for 'Recenter' or 'Current Quest'.

screens.name: Quest
screens.purpose: The gamified core: browse and track easy, medium, and hard location-based challenges.

states.empty: Illustration of an open treasure map, 'No active quests. Go explore!'

screens.layout: Tactile module layout: A sticky glass header with 'Active Quests' and filter chips (Easy, Med, Hard). Below, chunky rounded cards with progress bars, XP rewards, and clear CTA buttons ('Start', 'Check-in').

screens.name: Food
screens.purpose: A curated gastronomy guide emphasizing high-quality food photography and iconic local dishes.

states.empty: Illustration of a covered plate, 'No culinary spots found.'

screens.layout: Search-first, browse-fast pattern. Sticky search bar. Horizontal category tabs (Street Food, Fine Dining). Grid of cards with strong imagery, short descriptions, and 'Save' bookmark icons.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User's travel passport: tracking XP, levels, badges, and completed quests.
screens.layout: Magazine-like header with avatar, name, and current Level (e.g., 'Level 3: Explorer'). Prominent XP progress bar. A grid section for unlocked Badges, and a list of 'Recently Completed' quests below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT' base aesthetic: use elegant Fraunces serif for display typography to give a travel magazine feel, and DM Sans for clean body text.
The color palette strictly avoids AI-default blues and purples. Use the defined warm earth tones (Terracotta, Ochre, Olive) for a historic, premium, adventurous vibe.

Incorporate Tactile gamification elements: the Quest and Profile tabs should feature chunky rounded cards (`md` or `lg` radius), prominent progress bars, and touchable CTA buttons to make the gamification mechanics satisfying.
For the Food section, follow the search-first, browse-fast UX pattern found in research: implement a sticky search bar, horizontal category filters, and visually dominant image cards for dishes.

Implement Glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers. Always pair image overlays with a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom, transitioning to surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast against photography.
Include subtle haptics on tab presses, quest interactions, and level-ups to enhance the gamified experience.
